narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to parts of northern New Jersey on the evening of June 1. Rainfall totals as high as 2 to 3 inches fell in a short amount of time.
ev: Significant flooding occurred on several secondary roads in Mendham.
US Route 22 was closed in both directions in North Plainfield due to flooding.
